::: {#rem-argument-premises}
#### Two uses of "premise" and "conclusion"

The premise and conclusion of a conditional $P \Rightarrow Q$ (@rem-implies-terms)
are its parts $P$ and $Q$.
The premises and conclusion of an argument (@def-argument) are whole propositions:
in argument 1 of @exr-valid-arguments,
the premises are $P \Rightarrow Q$ and $P$, and the conclusion is $Q$.

:::
